name: @amaster.ai/pi-video-gen
description: Pi extension for AI video generation plus local video composition: lossless clip concat and mixed image/video timelines with overlays, TTS, soft or burned subtitles, source audio, BGM, and bundled LGPL/GPL FFmpeg runtimes.
